items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: Because Bird told me to take a solo and Dizzy came in.

ctx.x: Tell me, just to change the subject entirely, but since you mentioned it, what -- why don't you sort of fill us in on the details of that Massey Hall concert, how that happened to be? Who got the gig for that? You were the leader of that band, weren't you?

No. I can't think of the name of the guy. (inaudible) he wanted to book us to Japan. Yeah, Montreal. In Canada, You remember, Sue, Anyway, -- I think he lives in Toronto. Anyway, he called and said he wanted to get in touch with Dizzy Gillespie and Bud Powell, he wanted to use certain people. And I

think Dick Water was his name. My wife Celia really got it together. I didn't call nobody. I had a company and Max Roach decided to join it, and put the money up to record Charlie Parker, and Dizzy, at Jazz at Massey Hall. That was all.
